title: What happens when a job fails?

nodes.title: Claim the job
nodes.description: Take the next job from the queue. An empty queue ends the run.

nodes.title: Run the handler
nodes.description: Pass the job payload to the handler and wait for its result.

nodes.title: Requeue on failure
nodes.description: If attempts remain, requeue the job. When the attempt limit is reached, rethrow the error.

nodes.title: Save the result
nodes.description: Wait for the result to be written before acknowledging the job.

nodes.title: Acknowledge the job
nodes.description: Record the saved job ID in the completed set.
